extraction.Name: James Mousseau
extraction.Recorded patent: it was filed by S.W. Waddell, to whom I sold the land
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: The land was sold by me outright, not mortgaged
extraction.Buyer: W.S. Waddell, Martin, S.D., and received $4500.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: None of this land was sold for taxes or debts
extraction.Occupation/Income: I support myself by my own effort, with no assistance from the U.S.Government, with poor success
extraction.NOTES: Resides on Pine Ridge Reservation, in Bennett County; received fee patent by registered letter and receipted for; supports wife and partially supports three boys, all single and living at home but of legal age; states 'I was not defrauded out of this property in any manner'; believes $4500.00 was a fair consideration; paid in full by check; document also contains partial text from a separate affidavit by Charles Provost (No. 2189, Shannon County, South Dakota), age 63, post office Martin, South Dakota, allotment 320 acres, sold in 1920 to a man named Johnson of Vetal, South Dakota for $3300.00 cash, sold on account of not wishing to pay taxes; Provost stated he did not want his patent but accepted it after Indian Agency Office warned land would be assessed for taxes and sold; Provost has very poor health (back trouble and rheumatism, unable to work for 26 years), wife works in a restaurant, he works common labor when able, four children to support (one in poor health); sworn November 26, 1928
